title: 入力identity・Joint/EM・解析/モード出力の継続改良受入
status: F1-F4 implemented and locally accepted; real observations, remote CI and publication remain; one generated baseline directory cleanup denied

units.title: 入力identityとsnapshot所有の簡素化
changes: 内容更新を見落とすglobal size/mtime hash cacheを削除。独立loadでは内容revisionを計算。
snapshot recordと入力payloadを分け、正当なstage_input.json入力の上書きを解消。既存data.local_pathの相対参照を使い旧snapshotも維持。
外部prepareの一度loadしたsource_paths/revisionをcopyへ渡し、再loadを撤去。
units.acceptance: same-size/mtime復元更新とmanifest名衝突を再現・解消。96x512x512x1でload2から1、peak377から268MB、snapshot数値/revision/split一致。

units.title: Joint/EMの選択basisと所有work
changes: 切詰めbasisがview経由で未選択Vhを保持する問題を解消。選択vectorだけF順copy、全vector要求時は不要copyを省略。
sample list+stackを所有matrixへの直接充填へ変更。center/weight workを再利用。
EMの重複finite確認、full where temporary、観測entryの不要な再書込みを削除。solver/rank/ALS/ridge/init/保存属性を維持。
units.acceptance: 独立small-ALS oracleを含む53件成功。3手法のcoeff/field/basis/mean差0、peak約29〜58MB減。

units.title: 解析とモード出力の保持・費用の整理
changes: public analyze APIの詳細field既定値を維持し、YAML解析だけretain_fields=Falseで未使用fieldを保持しない。不要Aは逆変換前に解放。
prediction_secondsを予測・再構成だけへ統一。診断inverseと採点を除外。metadataの全D zerosはbroadcast、preview maskは一sampleだけ。
mode_fieldsの全response list+stackを最終arrayへの充填へ置換。mode reportは一responseずつ消費。
inverse呼出回数を固定するassertを削除し、数値一致へ置換。新YAML/public iterator/frameworkは増やさない。
units.acceptance: 解析の予測/全metric/sample統計がbytes一致。モード6手法の独立direct inverse oracle一致。64mode 512x512でpeak450から317MB、返却array bytes一致。

units.title: 配布と現仕様の同期
changes: 0.10.3 wheelをbuildし既存isolated base環境へ再インストール。distを現行2wheelへ整理。
現仕様のguideとplan/current statusを更新。過去の受入は履歴へ保持。
units.acceptance: development609pass/3skip、installed579pass/33skip、静的検査、旧14bundle、fresh process推論、原入力67件不変。

findings: 小さい選択basisがviewのbaseを通じ全Vhを保持。保存joblibは元々logicalKだけでありbundleサイズ改善とは扱わない。
same-sizeかつmtime復元の更新でglobal cacheが古いrevisionを返す。
stage_input.jsonという正当な元入力をsnapshot recordで上書き。
外部prepareが同じDatasetをcopyのために再load。
prediction_secondsの範囲がscore/detailedで不一致、representation inverse時間の計測漏れ。
未使用診断field、metadata D個のzero、モード全listとstackが不要な容量を持つ。

acceptance.skip_reasons: development 3 optional; installed 19 optional and 14 producer-Python-minor cases
acceptance.final_change_check: After the no-copy full-basis branch, all 53 joint/EM/projection numerical tests rerun successfully; installed-wheel full suite uses the final source.
acceptance.legacy_models: Actual 0.7.1 eight bundles and 0.9.0 six bundles pass in matching producer environment

input.scope: Sequential fresh Windows processes, one cold external-stage preparation each, generated 96x512x512x1 float32 input, one numeric thread; process peak includes input generation. Times are observations, not universal speedup. No fitting or whole-pipeline out-of-core claim.
input.tradeoff: Global metadata-keyed hash cache was removed: each independent load recomputes content revision, correctly handling same-size updates with preserved mtime. External prepare now validates/hashes once and reuses owned source paths for copying, rather than reloading the same source.

backend.scope: Generated workload, separate Windows process per version/method, one numerical thread, one fit. Float32 read-only strided fields, varying masks, weighted inner product. Timings are single cold calls; different method processes may overlap. Do not claim general speedup; no full out-of-core claim.
changes: Truncated basis owns only selected K vectors, without retaining the complete Vh storage; Fortran ordering is preserved.
Joint/EM snapshots and masks are allocated once and filled directly, rather than retaining per-sample float64 lists while stacking.
Joint centering/weighting uses owned work matrix. EM reuses centered work matrix across iterations.
EM observed mean uses where reduction without a full np.where temporary; observed entries are not rewritten after every missing-only update.
Removed duplicate observed-finite checks already enforced by preparation.
backend.remaining: Direct SVD still uses full snapshots and factorization workspace; EM still keeps original values, mask, filled snapshots and one centered work matrix. Method, solver, rank selection, iteration count, ridge, mean and initialization remain unchanged.

analysis.scope: One Windows process per version; one numerical thread. Generated DCT2/PCA workload. Peak includes fit; detailed error decomposition still calculates full fields while needed. No full-pipeline out-of-core claim.
analysis.interpretation: Detailed analysis still computes physical-field error terms. Releasing unused A coordinates before the second inverse reduces peak; omitting unrequested detailed fields reduces retained memory. This is one cold timing per version, not a universal speedup; measured total analysis time increased about 9 percent. Public default analyze APIs retain detailed fields, while YAML analysis consumes only predictions and statistics.

modes.scope: One process per version; 64 exact DCT mode responses at 512x512. Peak includes fitting; time is a single mode_fields call. No general speedup claim.
modes.change: Public mode_fields preallocates only its final requested array; mode report consumes responses one at a time after its reconstruction curve. No list of all fields plus stack copy, no new public API or YAML.
modes.tradeoff: Array return still retains all requested fields. Single cold times are not a speed claim; peak RSS reflects this generated workload only.

mode_independent_review.review: Selection order is supplied unchanged. Baseline subtraction is performed once at the same explicit reference, so affine and nonlinear responses preserve their numerical meaning. Preallocation adopts the first response dtype; all coordinates of each fitted inverse share that dtype. Reporting yields one response at a time and retains HTML output text only; complete mode/prefix fields are not collected.

completed: Removed global metadata-keyed hash cache, duplicate Dataset load, snapshot name collision, unwanted diagnostic retention and mode list+stack.
Removed duplicate EM finite/observed reassignment/full where work, baseline SVD hidden storage.
Replaced inverse-call-count assertion with numerical comparison; retained necessary mathematical, leakage and compatibility tests.
Generated large input capacity files were deleted after recording hashes; immutable old wheel, small evidence and reproduction scripts retained.
Obsolete dist 0.10.2 copy removed after SHA verification against retained baseline.
No new YAML switch, generic state machine, DAG, contract or diagnostic framework.

denied.reason: Automatic approval review rejected exec_command: blocked by policy

remaining: Real observations/future truth/physical boundary acceptance at actual N, spatial size, channels; measure time, RSS and temporary disk.
Remote Linux/Windows CI and distribution destination/publication; local acceptance does not claim remote execution.
Global SVD/factorization, EM original/mask/filled/work, GP, shared CV truth/support, exact pointwise tail and array-return output remain necessary capacity; optimize only measured dominant paths.

Arbitrary-point bands, condition/dependence-aware calibration, arbitrary PDE, 3D/moving geometry, neutral long-term state require separate scientific scope. SDK reintegration follows standalone acceptance.
Generated backend baseline_source cleanup was rejected by automatic approval review and remains retained.
